title: New bathroom experience?
content: Anyone seen *THIS* bathroom? I'm not using AI for obvious reasons, so I'm going to explain to the best of my ability what this place looked like. I remember going in from a random store and there were red walls with blue polka dots and the floor was like a carpet that was blue and had yellow and green squiggles and triangles? I remember the toilets had Red bowls but blue lids, And I remember the sinks looked like a weird blocky waterfall type thing? All of the colors were slightly muted though. Does anyone else know what I'm talking about? I've been going here very recently.
